degree_rationale: This teaching treats the most primal essences: the mystery of darkness's clash, the unleashing of war, the joining that drew darkness into the cosmos, and the foundational mystery of the molding of Adam — the first man — who ate and whose eyes saw forth. It deals not with mechanism or embodiment but with originating realities, the essence of the cosmic conflict and the first human form. This is celestial: it concerns what things are at their root.
direction_rationale: As the opening teaching of the entire corpus, it sits at the rising point — the origin from which all that follows unfolds. Its tone is generative and originary: the mystery of beginnings, the first molding, the first seeing. The treatment is not analytical but declarative-foundational, like the sun coming up. This is the eastern quality: ruling love at its inception.
grand_man_function: The inmost celestial of the Grand Man — the originating will/love from which the human form first proceeds. It corresponds to the seat of primal volition and identity, the "Adam" point where the divine intention takes its first human shape and the eyes first open.
title: How Adam was formed and ate from the tree (creation-fall fragment)
